name: SuspiciousActivityReport
description: The formal Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filed (or under preparation for filing) with the NCA UKFIU under POCA 2002 s338. Created by the KYC/AML Service (SVC-014) when the MLRO makes a decision to file. Contains all NCA SAR Online submission fields, the MLRO decision rationale, the NCA acknowledgement reference, filing timestamp, SLA compliance status, and the ongoing consent regime status where applicable. This is the bank's primary legal record of its discharge of the POCA 2002 disclosure obligation. All fields are subject to 7-year WORM retention. The customer (PER-001) must never be informed that this entity exists or has been created (POCA 2002 s333A tipping-off prohibition).
retention: 7 years WORM from decision date (MLR 2017 Regulation 40 — bank policy extends statutory 5-year minimum to 7 years)

fields.name: sar_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation.
fields.transparency_note: Internal identifier. Never surfaced to customer (PER-001). Never included in any customer-facing communication or API response.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001). Immutable after creation.
fields.transparency_note: Links SAR to Customer record. Access restricted to MLRO (PER-052) and Deputy MLRO (PER-053) only.

fields.name: investigation_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → SARInvestigationRecord.investigation_id (ENT-009). Immutable after creation.

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: automated_event | staff_disclosure | mlro_investigation. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: trigger_event_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when trigger_type = automated_event. Format: '<event_id>:<event_instance_uuid>' (e.g. 'EVT-006:c3d4e5f6-...'). Null otherwise.

fields.name: mlro_decision
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: file_sar | file_defensive_sar. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: mlro_decision_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date MLRO recorded formal filing decision. Immutable. Starts the 5-business-day SLA clock.

fields.name: mlro_decision_rationale
fields.validation_rule: Required. Free text. Minimum 200 characters. Must document specific grounds for suspicion with intelligence-bearing content. Immutable after sign-off.

fields.name: investigation_summary
fields.validation_rule: Required. Free text. Minimum 100 characters. Populated during SAR preparation to complete NCA SAR grounds of suspicion narrative.

fields.name: estimated_value_gbp
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Decimal to 2dp. Estimated value of suspicious activity in GBP. Null if not quantifiable. Must be >= 0.

fields.name: typology_codes
fields.validation_rule: Required. At least one NCA typology code. Values from NCA-published typology code list maintained in SVC-014.

fields.name: subject_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: individual | business. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: account_details
fields.validation_rule: Required if known. Array of: { account_id (UUID), sort_code (6 digits), account_number (8 digits), account_type (enum: current | savings | business) }.

fields.name: transaction_details
fields.validation_rule: Required if applicable. Array of: { transaction_date (ISO 8601), amount_gbp (decimal, 2dp), direction (enum: credit | debit), counterparty_name (string), counterparty_account (string), narrative (string) }.

fields.name: consent_requested
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. True if this is a consent SAR under POCA 2002 s338.

fields.name: consent_transaction_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when consent_requested = true. Internal transaction ID for which NCA consent is sought.

fields.name: nca_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Populated on NCA SAR Online acknowledgement. Immutable after creation. Null until filed.

fields.name: filed_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Populated when status = filed. Immutable. Used for SLA compliance calculation.

fields.name: consent_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: not_applicable | awaiting_nca_response | granted | refused | moratorium_active | moratorium_expired. Default: not_applicable when consent_requested = false.

fields.name: moratorium_expiry_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when consent_status = moratorium_active. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Filed_date + 7 calendar days (initial NCA moratorium).

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: draft | ready_for_submission | filed | closed. Transitions: draft → ready_for_submission → filed → closed.

fields.name: sla_status
fields.validation_rule: System-computed. Enum: within_sla | warning | breached. Immutable once breached.

fields.name: mlro_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Staff.staff_id. Must reference MLRO-role holder. Immutable.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. WORM — all versions retained.

relationships.description: SuspiciousActivityReport belongs to one Customer (customer_id FK). A customer may be the subject of multiple SARs over the relationship lifetime.
SuspiciousActivityReport is produced from one SARInvestigationRecord (investigation_id FK).

design_decisions.decision: SuspiciousActivityReport is a separate entity from SARInvestigationRecord. A dismissed investigation produces a SARInvestigationRecord but no SuspiciousActivityReport.
design_decisions.rationale: Keeps the legal NCA filing record separate from the internal investigation workpaper. Supports the dismissed-investigation scenario without creating a SAR entity.

design_decisions.decision: Subject identity data (name, DOB, address) is NOT duplicated into SuspiciousActivityReport. The NCA form is assembled at submission time by reading ENT-001.
design_decisions.rationale: Consistent with the Single Customer View principle. Avoids PII duplication. MLRO confirms accuracy as part of the submission review.
